name: Crab
traits: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player rules for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printing.
Small Beast. No ability score increase. Walking speed 25 ft., swim speed 20 ft. Blindsight 60 ft. Unarmored AC is 11 + Dexterity modifier.
Claw is an unarmed strike for 1d4 slashing. The crab lacks hands for weapons, shields, spellcasting foci, wands, tools, and other items that require manipulation.
Speaks, reads, and writes Common. The trait block grants swim speed and uses the ordinary breathing rules.

name: Crocodile
traits: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player rules for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printing.
Medium Beast. Increase Strength by 2. Walking speed 20 ft., swim speed 30 ft. Unarmored AC is 12 + Dexterity modifier.
Bite is an unarmed strike for 1d8 piercing. When an unarmed strike made with the Attack action hits, the crocodile can try to grapple that creature as a bonus action.
Speaks, reads, and writes Common. The Giant Crocodile entry on p. 235 refers players to these same traits.

name: Deer
traits: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player rules for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printing.
Medium Beast. Increase Dexterity by 2 and Wisdom by 1. Walking speed 50 ft.
Gore is an unarmed strike for 1d4 piercing. The deer lacks hands for weapons, shields, spellcasting foci, wands, tools, and other items that need manipulation.
Speaks, reads, and writes Common.

name: Eagle
traits: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player rules for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printing.
Small Beast. Increase Dexterity and Wisdom by 1 each. Walking speed 10 ft., fly speed 60 ft. Flight is unavailable in medium or heavy armor.
Keen Sight grants advantage on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks. The eagle lacks hands for weapons, shields, foci, wands, tools, and items that need manipulation.
Talons are an unarmed strike for 1d4 piercing. Dexterity can replace Strength for the attack and damage, and Talons count as a finesse weapon for effects such as Sneak Attack.
Speaks, reads, and writes Common.

name: Elephant
traits: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player rules for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printing.
Medium Beast. Increase Strength and Constitution by 2 each. Walking speed 35 ft. Unarmored AC is 13 + Dexterity modifier.
Gore and Stomp are unarmed strikes for 1d8 piercing or bludgeoning. The elephant lacks hands for weapons, shields, foci, wands, tools, and items that need manipulation.
Trampling Charge allows a bonus-action shove to knock a target prone after moving at least 15 ft. straight toward it and hitting it with an unarmed strike on that turn.
Speaks, reads, and writes Common. The Mammoth entry on p. 252 refers players to these same traits.
